name: liouville_harmonic_classical
divergence_log: Classical Liouville equation propagates a non-negative density on commuting coordinates (q, p). The Wigner/Weyl quantum analog allows negative values, signals non-classical states (Fock, cat, squeezed), and the flow is no longer a rigid symplectic rotation outside quadratic Hamiltonians. This baseline cannot encode Moyal-bracket corrections or interference between classically distinct trajectories.
